Gears of War 2.name: Gears of War 2
Gears of War 2.summary: Gears of War 2 is a third-person shooter built around tactical use of cover. Players fight through a campaign as a soldier of the Coalition of Ordered Governments, carrying a limited loadout of weapons and using cover, melee attacks, and the series' chainsaw bayonet against enemy forces. It supports cooperative campaign play and a range of competitive multiplayer modes, and introduces Horde mode, in which up to five players survive escalating waves of enemies together.

James Cameron's Avatar The Game.name: James Cameron's Avatar: The Game
James Cameron's Avatar The Game.summary: James Cameron's Avatar: The Game is the official video game based on the highly anticipated film James Cameron's Avatar.

Just Dance - Greatest Hits.name: Just Dance: Greatest Hits
Just Dance - Greatest Hits.summary: Just Dance: Greatest Hits is part of the Just Dance video game series published by Ubisoft. The game includes songs from Just Dance, Just Dance 2, Just Dance: Summer Party, and Just Dance 3, with 25 songs in the Wii PAL (Europe) counterpart (Best Of) and 35 songs in the NTSC (North America) Wii and Xbox 360 version (Greatest Hits). It is only available on the NTSC Wii and the Xbox 360.

Madden NFL 08.name: Madden NFL 08
Madden NFL 08.summary: Madden NFL 08, 2007's ode to NFL football on videogame consoles, fits like an old glove. Gamers will be familiar with how the game plays and feels. But as usual, updated team rosters (with their inherent strengths and weaknesses), enhanced graphics, and new in-game features will keep you, the gamer, plenty interested.
